# Projection

`<fixtures>/schema.tsare`

Quoted text is a field, copied verbatim: a paraphrase of a claim is a new claim.
The indented note under each quote is the projection's own -- what the sentence
stands on, who checks it, and what is still owed.

### F_TRACE -- fact

> the list renders at 60 fps under trace

  evidence: tool("trace") | obligation: check (ready)

### F_HEADLESS -- fact

> nothing renders with --headless

  evidence: tool("run --headless") | obligation: check (ready)

### C_RENDERED -- concept

> the list is rendered

  grounded_by: F_TRACE | against: F_HEADLESS | obligation: induce (blocked), no clause found; see OPEN.md

### P_SMOOTH -- proposition

> scrolling feels smooth

  uses: C_RENDERED | obligation: prove (assumed), no premises; treated as an assumption

### P_STABLE -- proposition

> frame times stay under 16 ms while scrolling

  uses: C_RENDERED | obligation: prove (assumed), no premises; treated as an assumption

### W_RULE -- warrant

> a traced render is evidence enough for any rendering claim

  from: F_TRACE | concludes: uses: C_RENDERED | basis: C_RENDERED | obligation: justify (ready)
